note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. A neutral filing arrangement only: folder A (the original file, with a placeholder decision sheet whose content is never shown) and folder B (a separate folder for the proposed additional pieces) have the same size and stroke and differ only by their lane colour (blue / amber) and their side of a neutral divider, which decides nothing. The pieces are placeholder sheets; the reason noted by the proposer (grounds) is shown as supplied and never assessed. The two supplied states have equal weight: ● kept-separate (both folders closed) and ◆ open-for-review (folder B left open). No admissibility rule, assessment, time limit, outcome or jurisdiction is drawn. Brief fields: decisions, grounds, routes, outcomes, objectLabels, actionProgress, annotations and finalState are editable; actorLabels maps to courier.label (the participant) and routes.original / routes.additional (the two folders).
